blocks.translation:
• This product is for ages 15 and up. Do not give it to children under 15 under any circumstances.
• This product contains small parts; keep it away from young children who might accidentally swallow them. There is a choking hazard.
• Do not use this product close to the ear. Incorrect use may damage hearing.
• This product contains electronic components; people with pacemakers should take care.
• Do not hit, swing, or play roughly with this product.
• Do not put fingers or other body parts into moving parts. There is a risk of being pinched and injured.
• Incorrect use of batteries may cause heating, rupture, or leakage. Observe the following precautions.
• Never use secondary (rechargeable) batteries.
• Do not mix old and new batteries or different types of batteries.
• Insert batteries with correct + and − polarity.
• Always turn off the switch and remove the batteries after playing. Leaving batteries installed may cause leakage and is dangerous.
• Do not short-circuit, charge, disassemble, heat, or put batteries into fire.
• If battery fluid gets into the eyes, rinse immediately with plenty of water and consult a doctor. If battery fluid contacts skin or clothing, wash with water.
• When disposing of the product or batteries, follow your local municipal waste disposal regulations.

blocks.translation:
• Precautions for use
• This product contains delicate electronic components. Do not drop it, get it wet, soil it, or disassemble it. Also avoid using or storing it in very hot or very cold places.
• Discard plastic packing material immediately after opening.
• Do not place this product on resin sofas, seats, tiles, or similar surfaces. Prolonged contact may cause color transfer.
• Do not pull or bend moving parts or attachment parts forcefully in directions they are not meant to move.
• Some voice lines may have different intonation or can be hard to hear because of the product's characteristics. Two units cannot be used at the same time. If the product malfunctions, turn the power off and on again.
• Do not put stickers or tape over the receiver or transmitter areas; doing so will stop operation. The product will not work if there are obstacles between the receiver and transmitter.
• This product is made precisely. Applying excessive force or dropping it may cause damage.
• When returning the product to the packaging for storage, always put it in a bag.
• Because of the product's characteristics, appearance may vary.

source_blocks.translation: ※Activate the Den-O Belt of "CSM Den-O Belt & K-Taros ver.2" in "A: DenGasher Link Mode".

source_blocks.text:
デンオウベルトにライダーパスをかざして必殺技操作を行います。
デンガッシャー側のモードを、デンオウベルトのフォームに合わせている場合、
デンオウベルト側から「フルチャージ」等の音声が鳴った後、
デンガッシャー側から必殺待機音が鳴り、
続けてトリガーを押すことで必殺技音が発動します。
source_blocks.translation:
Hold the Rider Pass over the Den-O Belt to perform special move operations.
If the DenGasher's mode is set to match the Den-O Belt's form, then after the Den-O Belt plays a voice such as "Full Charge," a special-move standby sound will play from the DenGasher, and pressing the trigger will activate the special move sound.

source_blocks.text:
※必殺技はp.16~18の表の分収録しており、デンオウベルト側の
取扱説明書に記載された順番の必殺技音に対応して、
デンガッシャー側から続きの音声が鳴ります。
source_blocks.translation: ※The special move sounds listed in the tables on pp.16–18 are recorded. The DenGasher will play the continuation sounds corresponding to the order of special move sounds listed in the Den-O Belt's instruction manual.

source_blocks.text:
※通信を行う際、デンガッシャーのパーツ四番の底面が
デンオウベルトから離れすぎないようにしてください。
また底面にある穴は塞がないでください。
※通信が失敗する場合があります。
その場合は、デンガッシャーのパーツ四番の底面を
デンオウベルトの方に向けて近づけて、
必殺技を発動させてください。
source_blocks.translation: ※When communicating, make sure the bottom of DenGasher Part 4 does not get too far from the Den-O Belt. Also do not block the hole on the bottom. ※Communication may fail. If this happens, face the bottom of DenGasher Part 4 toward the Den-O Belt, bring it closer, and then activate the special move.

CSMデンオウベルト&ケータロスver.2との連動必殺技遊び
※「CSMデンオウベルト&ケータロスver.2」のデンオウベルトを「A:デンガッシャー連動モード」で起動します。
デンオウベルトにライダーパスをかざして必殺技操作を行います。
デンガッシャー側のモードを、デンオウベルトのフォームに合わせている場合、デンオウベルト側から「フルチャージ」等の音声が鳴った後、デンガッシャー側から必殺待機音が鳴り、続けてトリガーを押すことで必殺技音が発動します。
必殺技はp.16~18の表の分収録しており、デンオウベルト側の取扱説明書に記載された順番の必殺技音に対応して、デンガッシャー側から続きの音声が鳴ります。
※通信を行う際、デンガッシャーのパーツ四番の底面がデンオウベルトから離れすぎないようにしてください。また底面にある穴は塞がないでください。
※通信が失敗する場合があります。その場合は、デンガッシャーのパーツ四番の底面をデンオウベルトの方に向けて近づけて、必殺技を発動させてください。
